paragraph: [In May 2025 LBC, the contractor, said the technical-vocational education system SIETP was designed for integration with SIGE](<https://lbc-global.com/en/retfop-um-ponto-de-viragem-no-ensino-tecnico-profissional-angolano/>). [SIGE is Angola's Education Information and Management System](<https://lbc-global.com/en/retfop-um-ponto-de-viragem-no-ensino-tecnico-profissional-angolano/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the two systems exchange data in use, or that one learner identifier is used across education systems. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

[From 29 July to 2 August 2024 the ministry and UNESCO held a workshop on a human resources module for the central SIGE](<https://mesrs.gov.bi/atelier-dappropriation-et-de-revue-de-la-planification-des-activites-du-projet-dappui-a-loperationnalisation-du-module-de-gestion-des-ressources-humaines-du-sige-burundi/>). [The module is to work with the STATEDUC application and serve teacher recruitment, deployment and posting](<https://mesrs.gov.bi/atelier-dappropriation-et-de-revue-de-la-planification-des-activites-du-projet-dappui-a-loperationnalisation-du-module-de-gestion-des-ressources-humaines-du-sige-burundi/>). [The project was agreed in December 2022 and runs to 14 February 2026](<https://mesrs.gov.bi/atelier-dappropriation-et-de-revue-de-la-planification-des-activites-du-projet-dappui-a-loperationnalisation-du-module-de-gestion-des-ressources-humaines-du-sige-burundi/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the module is in service or that two education systems exchange data. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use: the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

[On 25 June 2025 the digital transition and basic education ministers reviewed progress on the national pupil file, online enrolment and school identity cards, La Tribune du Faso reports](<https://www.latribunedufaso.net/?p=21538>). [Built with WURI support, the file is to track pupils from primary to university](<https://www.latribunedufaso.net/?p=21538>). [In February 2024 a ministry report recorded a pilot of the unique pupil identification file, FIUE-BF](<https://sp-psdebs.education-bf.com/uploads/document/U-1756488494.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data in use. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

[In June 2026 a World Bank completion report said the HRMIS built under the Education Sector Plan Support Project is linked to the payroll](<https://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099061526153018839/pdf/BOSIB-a5df712a-2126-49ab-8538-d2e23c305751.pdf>). [It records 98.01 percent of teachers on payroll with a certificate of presence, against a 95 percent target](<https://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099061526153018839/pdf/BOSIB-a5df712a-2126-49ab-8538-d2e23c305751.pdf>). [The CARE project uses it for teacher recruitment and deployment](<https://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099061526153018839/pdf/BOSIB-a5df712a-2126-49ab-8538-d2e23c305751.pdf>). The report dates from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems. Operating would need learners to carry a unique identifier used by two or more education systems.

[On 31 July 2026 UNESCO and Cameroon's PAEBC project unit signed a technical assistance agreement](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/lunesco-et-le-cameroun-signent-un-accord-pour-la-mise-en-oeuvre-du-projet-dappui-leducation-de-base>). [It is worth 8 million euros over 36 months](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/lunesco-et-le-cameroun-signent-un-accord-pour-la-mise-en-oeuvre-du-projet-dappui-leducation-de-base>). [It includes updating the MINEDUB WebSIG platform and interconnecting the education databases](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/lunesco-et-le-cameroun-signent-un-accord-pour-la-mise-en-oeuvre-du-projet-dappui-leducation-de-base>). The agreement dates from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data in use. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

[In August 2026 the director of SERNIE, the national pupil records service, wrote that other education departments collect teacher and school-infrastructure data](<https://corusinternational.org/fr/blog/2026/case-scaling-education-data-drc>). [They collect it separately from SERNIE's learner records](<https://corusinternational.org/fr/blog/2026/case-scaling-education-data-drc>). [The director stated no link between them](<https://corusinternational.org/fr/blog/2026/case-scaling-education-data-drc>). The article dates from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a link between education systems is under way. Preparing would need a link between two education systems to be contracted, being built or piloted.

[From November 2025 a UNICEF-backed project has worked to connect local school, woreda and zone systems to the national DHIS2-Ed EMIS](<https://education.dhis2.org/using-data-to-power-teaching-at-the-right-level-in-ethiopia/>). [It covers the SER, SWEPR, Oromia and Benishangul Gumuz regions, HISP Ethiopia reports](<https://education.dhis2.org/using-data-to-power-teaching-at-the-right-level-in-ethiopia/>). In the last twelve months, [in March 2026 the World Bank proposed US$750,000 for EMIS enhancement](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099032326144529868/pdf/BOSIB-3d398de8-e525-4d3e-bf20-dd47590f809c.pdf>). It would [bring all 57 refugee primary schools and their learners into the national EMIS](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099032326144529868/pdf/BOSIB-3d398de8-e525-4d3e-bf20-dd47590f809c.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data. None says they do in service. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body or teacher payroll.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 names education systems exchanging data. Sources found name a [Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)](<https://gabonmediatime.com/gabon-integration-de-la-sante-scolaire-dans-le-systeme-de-gestion-educative>) and an [exam management database](<https://pointnoirtv.com/2025/03/11/gabon-renforcement-de-la-collecte-des-donnees-scolaires-une-priorite-pour-le-ministere-de-leducation-nationale>), and show no link between them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says the country's education systems exchange no data.

[In 2024 the Ministry of Education's PMDV Dashboard API documentation listed endpoints serving EMIS school statistics, enrolment rates, schools and NST test scores](<https://pmdv.moedatadashboard.com/api_documentation>). [A further endpoint takes data from agencies by agency code](<https://pmdv.moedatadashboard.com/api_documentation>). [It does not say which systems feed it or that it is in service](<https://pmdv.moedatadashboard.com/api_documentation>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data in use. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

In September 2025 the Minister of Higher Education [announced the Système Intégré de Gestion des Universités (SIGU) as a centralised digital tool interconnected with other national platforms](<https://guineejet.info/lancement-de-latelier-national-dimmatriculation-des-bacheliers-de-2025/>), named as ANSAE, the Porte Educ platform and SIGOU. [In March 2021 exam candidate lists passed between central level, IRE, DPE and schools by agents' personal email in Excel files](<https://mepua.gov.gn/file/2023/10/Rapport-final-activites.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the EMIS exchanges data with another education system in use. Examinations, payroll and learner registration were looked for. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use.

[In July 2026 the education and health ministries signed an MoU to link the EMIS with the HMIS](<https://gambiana.com/mobse-and-health-ministry-sign-deal-to-link-education-and-health-data-systems/>). [The link is planned, not yet running](<https://gambiana.com/mobse-and-health-ministry-sign-deal-to-link-education-and-health-data-systems/>). The MoU dates from the last twelve months. [In October 2022 a DHIS2 for Education use case found separate databases for HR, examinations and infrastructure](<https://education.dhis2.org/wp-content/uploads/UO-DHIS2-CO_Gambia-Long-screen.pdf>), and [none brought them together](<https://education.dhis2.org/wp-content/uploads/UO-DHIS2-CO_Gambia-Long-screen.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data in use. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

The Principal Secretary for basic education said KEMIS would [go live on 9 January 2026 and integrate basic education, higher education and TVET with the examinations council and the Teachers Service Commission](<https://educationnews.co.ke/government-to-roll-out-kemis-on-january-9-2026-to-track-learners-nationwide/>). [A Ministry of Education circular says the KEMIS Learner Validation Engine is operational](<https://arena.co.ke/ministry-circular-guidance-on-learner-validation-in-kemis/>). It compares learner records with the official examination and assessment databases. In the last twelve months, in September 2026, [a State House meeting with the Public Service Commission, the examinations council and the ministry](<https://nairobiwire.com/2026/09/kenya-academic-certificate-verification-fake-certificates.html>) agreed to integrate the systems that authenticate academic certificates. No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems. Operating would need learners to carry a unique identifier used by two or more education systems.

[An AU-IPED peer review held on 1-2 September 2025 found Liberia's EMIS has no integration with WAEC exam data](<https://www.iped.africa/media/Liberia_Emis_Review_Report_Final.pdf>). [It found no integration with teacher service records either](<https://www.iped.africa/media/Liberia_Emis_Review_Report_Final.pdf>). [The exams, curriculum and teacher databases are not linked](<https://www.iped.africa/media/Liberia_Emis_Review_Report_Final.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a link between education systems is under way. Preparing would need a link between two education systems to be contracted, being built or piloted.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 names two education systems exchanging data, or says none do. Sources found name an [Education Management Information System (EMIS)](<https://libyaobserver.ly/education/education-ministry-launches-emis-cooperation-unicef>), an [OpenEMIS](<https://dic.moe.gov.ly/%d9%88%d8%b1%d8%b4%d8%a9-%d8%b9%d9%85%d9%84-%d8%ad%d9%88%d9%84-%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%a7%d9%85-open-emis/>) and an [Education GIS](<https://dic.moe.gov.ly/projects/>), without showing a link between them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says the country's education systems exchange no data.

No stage is set. [A ministry circular of 2024 has school heads and provincial offices register and check pupils' records in Massar](<https://ar.hibapress.com/details-517593.html>). [It gives each pupil a digital identifier in Massar](<https://ar.hibapress.com/details-517593.html>), with a single national learner register as the aim. [Massar's online enrolment services for parents rely on digital identity and can download the pupil's data held in the civil status register](<https://ar.hibapress.com/details-517593.html>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 names two education systems exchanging data. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

On 5 June 2025 the PASCOFI project, run by EUMC and funded by Global Affairs Canada, [called for a consultant to strengthen the ministry's education management system so that JIGITUGU can be integrated with it](<https://www.malipages.com/appel-offre/acquisition-et-dotation-en-materiels-informatique/>). The work includes [a module to synchronise the ministry's education portal with JIGITUGU, by API or webhook](<https://www.malipages.com/appel-offre/acquisition-et-dotation-en-materiels-informatique/>). JIGITUGU collects pupils' and teachers' attendance and pupils' results in real time. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Nothing found says the link is in use. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

No stage is set. [In July 2025 the education ministry launched a service on the Houwiyati platform to extract and confirm national certificates](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/276019>). [It covers certificates issued after 2013 or already linked to the holder's national number (NNI)](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/276019>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 names a link between education systems at any stage. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

[In July 2026 the Unlocking Data Initiative Malawi team was developing an Education Data Portal (EDaP)](<https://unlockingdata.africa/2026/07/06/unlocking-malawis-foundational-learning-data-for-better-learning-outcomes/>). [It is to bring together datasets from the education ministry, MoEST, which runs the EMIS](<https://unlockingdata.africa/2026/07/06/unlocking-malawis-foundational-learning-data-for-better-learning-outcomes/>). [Other datasets come from the gender and social welfare ministry, the National Statistics Office, development partners and academia](<https://unlockingdata.africa/2026/07/06/unlocking-malawis-foundational-learning-data-for-better-learning-outcomes/>). The portal work dates from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data in use. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

[In 2026 Biometric Update reported that the Ministry of Education and NIMC integrated the Learner's Identification Number of 80 million students with the NIN registry](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/nigeria-integrates-national-student-ids-digital-identity-system>), done via the digital NEMIS. [The Federal Government says it launched the nationwide Learner Identification Number, building on DNEMIS](<https://fmino.gov.ng/fg-launches-first-ever-nationwide-learner-identification-number-to-transform-education-system/>). [It says over 1.9 million candidates registered for the 2026 WAEC and NECO examinations have been issued one in the first phase](<https://fmino.gov.ng/fg-launches-first-ever-nationwide-learner-identification-number-to-transform-education-system/>). These reports date from 2026, within the last twelve months. [The Minister of Education said more than 250 higher education institutions are integrated with the Nigeria Education Repository and Data Bank (NERD)](<https://fmino.gov.ng/fg-deploys-national-education-data-repository-to-end-certificate-fraud-strengthen-academic-records-integrity/>).

In February 2026 HISP Rwanda [worked with the education ministry on integrating SDMS, SEMIS and partner platforms](<https://hisprwanda.org/hisp-rwanda-partners-with-save-the-children-waliku-and-mineduc-to-strengthen-education-data-systems-and-advance-zero-out-of-school-children-goal/>). In May 2026 the national ID agency said [the ministry was integrating education data systems with the Single Digital Identity](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-1-Rwanda-FINAL.pdf>). It named harmonising the EMIS with the population register for children under 16 as a challenge. Both reports date from the last twelve months. No source found says which education systems already exchange data. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

No stage is set. [The ministry's GREEN guide says every pupil and teacher has a national education number](<https://senprof.education.sn/GUIDES%20ET%20DOCUMENTATIONS/GUIDE%20GREEN>), the IEN. [The ministry says the IEN is deployed nationwide](<https://senprof.education.sn/GUIDES%20ET%20DOCUMENTATIONS/GUIDE%20GREEN>). No source names a second system that uses it. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source since October 2023 names two education systems exchanging data or using one learner identifier. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

[In April 2026 MBSSE launched work, funded by GPE with UNICEF support, on a DHIS2-based national education data hub](<https://dhis2.org/sierra-leone-national-education-data-hub/>). [Its interoperability layer will connect the annual school census, teacher management, learning assessments, school quality data and examination results](<https://dhis2.org/sierra-leone-national-education-data-hub/>). [It is rolling out across all 16 districts](<https://dhis2.org/sierra-leone-national-education-data-hub/>). The launch dates from the last twelve months. The same source says [those records are held in separate systems, with no reliable way to track a learner across them](<https://dhis2.org/sierra-leone-national-education-data-hub/>). No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data in use. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

In May 2026 GovStack's showcase page showed [the High School Certificate System connecting the MOECHE Examination System registry](<https://govstack.global/showcase/somalia-hsc/>). [Exam results are retrieved automatically and verified digital certificates are issued online](<https://govstack.global/showcase/somalia-hsc/>). [Somalia's Finance Minister countersigned the World Bank letter of amendment on 2 October 2025](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099100225092557188/pdf/P172434-c7c7f078-1bc2-439f-a6a6-aa0c69ca52b6.pdf>), which [finances expansion of the Teacher Management Information System and its integration with the EMIS](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099100225092557188/pdf/P172434-c7c7f078-1bc2-439f-a6a6-aa0c69ca52b6.pdf>). The showcase page dates from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems. Operating would need learners to carry a unique identifier used by two or more education systems.

[In September 2025 an ERICC working paper said REMIS, UNHCR's refugee education data system, relies on data from the ministry's EMIS](<https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.30192664>). [Only the ministry receives REMIS enrolment and attendance data](<https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.30192664>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems. Operating would need learners to carry a unique identifier used by two or more education systems.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 names education systems exchanging data. Sources found name a [Sistema Integrado de Gestão Escolar (SIGE)](<https://www.telanon.info/anuncios/2026/04/01/52396/afap-consultoria-a-t-especializada-em-infraestruturas-tecnologicas-gestao-de-recursos-e-capacitacao-para-implementacao-do-sistema-integrado-de-gestao-escolar-sige/>) and [dashboards for national education supervision](<https://www.telanon.info/anuncios/2026/05/07/52802/unicef-contratacao-de-uma-instituicao-de-ensino-superior-universidade-para-o-desenvolvimento-de-dashboards-para-a-supervisao-educativa-nacional/>), and show no link between them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says the country's education systems exchange no data.

No stage is set. [In 2024 the DHIS2 for Education profile described Eswatini's EMIS data as connected to national identity](<https://education.dhis2.org/implementation/eswatini/>). [The SEMIS App holds individual learner and staff data by PIN and has been national in scale since a 2020 pilot](<https://education.dhis2.org/implementation/eswatini/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a link between education systems is contracted, being built, piloted or in service. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 names education systems exchanging data. Sources found name a [Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation (SIGE)](<https://www.unesco.org/fr/articles/investir-dans-les-donnees-pour-transformer-leducation-au-tchad-lunesco-remet-des-equipements>) and a [UNHCR refugee-school EMIS](<https://www.educationcannotwait.org/sites/default/files/2022-03/Strengthening%20Education%20Management%20Information%20Systems%20%28EMIS%29%20and%20Data%20for%20Increased%20Resilience%20to%20Crisis_%20country%20case%20study_%20Chad.pdf>), and show no link between them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says the country's education systems exchange no data.

[In 2025 the implementing researchers and Ministry staff stated that Togo's ministry has developed an integrated education data system, StatEduc with DHIS2](<https://www.gpekix.org/blog/togo-empowering-schools-and-districts-data>). [It connects the Department of Planning, the Examinations Department and the General Inspectorate of Education](<https://www.gpekix.org/blog/togo-empowering-schools-and-districts-data>). [A World Bank mission noted non-appropriation of the project to interconnect platforms and databases](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099011425201027440/pdf/P172674-dd66e6f3-560a-4916-b99c-93ecb5bb6f4a.pdf>), under the basic education project P172674. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems. Operating would need learners to carry a unique identifier used by two or more education systems.

[The Teachers Service Commission said in August 2024 that its teacher information system, TSCMIS, is connected to three other systems](<https://www.tsc.go.tz/news/tsc-imefanikiwa-kuunganisha-mfumo-wa-tscmis-na-mifumo-mingine-mitatu>): the School Information System, the civil service HR system and the Treasury pensions system. The links exchange teacher data. In the last twelve months, [on 13 July 2026 the Permanent Secretary told institutions to speed up linking their platforms to the Education Sector Management Information System](<https://dailynews.co.tz/schools-told-to-align-courses-with-market-needs/>). No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems. Operating would need one learner identifier used by two or more education systems.

In June 2026 the ministry's statistics lead said [the EMIS lacks integration with the national examinations board's system](<https://www.thekampalareport.com/latest/community/2026060963856/concerns-grow-as-private-firm-retains-control-of-critical-education-data-system.html>), so not all Senior One and Senior Five students are captured. [He said the ministries and the board are working to close the gap](<https://www.thekampalareport.com/latest/community/2026060963856/concerns-grow-as-private-firm-retains-control-of-critical-education-data-system.html>). In the last twelve months, a HISP Uganda brief of April 2026 said [2025 primary leaving results were brought into DHIS2 for Education](<https://website.hispuganda.org/pdfs/PolicybriefPDHIS2EdTermlySchoolReportinUganda.pdf>). In 2023 that platform ran in [10 of 175 administrative sites](<https://education.dhis2.org/routine-data-collection-uganda/>). No source found since October 2023 says the national EMIS exchanges data with another system in service. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.

The Department of Basic Education told Parliament in December 2025 that [LURITS, its learner register, consolidates the learner records schools submit](<https://pmg.org.za/committee-question/35150/>). Schools submit them through provincial school administration systems and provincial data warehouses. In August 2026 MICT SETA told Parliament that [an Integrated Learner Management System is being piloted in a couple of SETAs](<https://www.parliament.gov.za/news/dispute-over-intellectual-property-could-derail-leaner-management-system>), to join the post-school bodies' systems in one platform. Both statements date from the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says one learner identifier is used across education systems. Operating would need learners to carry a unique identifier used by two or more education systems.

[In April 2026 UNICEF sought a consultant to build a web-based school registration system for the education ministry](<https://jobs.unicef.org/en-us/job/592432/development-of-an-information-management-system-for-school-registration-at-the-ministry-of-primary-and-secondary-education-harare-zimbabve-5-months-nationals-only-home-based>). [The system is to be integrated with the EMIS](<https://jobs.unicef.org/en-us/job/592432/development-of-an-information-management-system-for-school-registration-at-the-ministry-of-primary-and-secondary-education-harare-zimbabve-5-months-nationals-only-home-based>). In June 2026 the ministry's spokesperson said [an Early Warning System is now part of the EMIS](<https://www.newzimbabwe.com/zimbabwe-targets-to-re-enrol-out-of-school-learners-as-40000-dropped-out-in-2025-alone/>). These steps date from the last twelve months. [In 2019 an ADEA peer review found no formal structures for sharing data among education stakeholders](<https://www.adeanet.org/sites/default/files/zimbabwe_education_management_information_systems_peer_review_report.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says two education systems exchange data in service. Establishing would need two education systems exchanging data in use, such as the EMIS with the examinations body, teacher payroll or learner registration.
